description: This file defines the implementation of the HistoryItemViewModel class, which manages the data and accessibility features for a history item in a calculator app, including generating accessible expressions from tokens and managing related properties.

classes.name: HistoryItemViewModel
classes.description: A view model class representing a history item in the calculator app, providing properties for expression, result, and accessibility features.

methods.name: HistoryItemViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view model with expression, result, tokens, and commands, and setting accessibility properties.

methods.name: GetAccessibleExpressionFromTokens
methods.description: Generates an accessible string representation of the expression from tokens for screen readers.
